summary: Backend-only testing for ArUco multi-photo reconstruction (iter12). All 9 tests passed. Verified: (1) GET /api/aruco/sheet.pdf?mm=40 returns HTTP 200 with content-type application/pdf, valid %PDF header, ~30KB body; custom mm=60 also works. (2) POST /api/projects/6a82a5c817fe4d8f4b6783f0/photogram/aruco {marker_mm:50} returned 200, status='processed', photos_used>=1, markers_found>=1, contour_mm with >=3 pts, rectified_url downloadable. (3) POST /photogram/aruco on markerless photos returned HTTP 422 (not 500) with Italian detail message; backend GET /api/ remained 200 after the call. (4) POST /photogram/aruco on an empty project returned HTTP 400 with 'foto' in the italian detail. (5) REGRESSION /photogram/stitch returns {mosaic_url,w,h,warning} and backend stayed up. (6) REGRESSION /photogram/extract works for both type:'line' and type:'rect', persisting status='processed' with contour_mm.
critical_code_review_comments: aruco_stitch.process correctly raises ValueError with Italian messages, and the /photogram/aruco endpoint maps ValueError -> HTTPException(422), preventing 500s.
OpenCV Stitcher removed from photogram.prepare_image (now picks sharpest photo). Signature returns (image, warning), consistent with /photogram/stitch response contract.
seed_data_creation: Test file uses pre-seeded project id 6a82a5c817fe4d8f4b6783f0 provided by main agent. Also creates and cleans up temporary TEST_* projects for the empty/markerless/stitch/extract regression cases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<public-url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_aruco.py -v. The dev backend has a periodic ~6-minute uvicorn reload that may briefly return 502/503 — the test file already has a small retry helper for that. Pre-seeded ArUco project 6a82a5c817fe4d8f4b6783f0 is required for TestArucoPreseeded; if it disappears, regenerate synthetic photos with cv2.aruco.generateImageMarker (DICT_4X4_50), pad a white quiet-zone border, and ensure two images share at least one marker id.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All requested feature checks (sheet.pdf, aruco happy path, no-markers 422 with Italian text + backend alive, empty project 400, stitch and extract regressions) passed.
